feature_title: Online Evals LLM Provider Types & API Key Handling

rationale.edition: The change spans both OSS and enterprise layers. OSS core is touched via src/core/src/providers.rs (the shared provider-table update logic and new resolve_updated_auth_config helper), while enterprise-gated locations include web/src/enterprise/components/onlineEvals/forms/ProviderFormPage.vue and o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/llm_evaluations/provider.rs. Enterprise keywords (llm_evaluations, onlineEvals) are present in the changed paths, corroborating the enterprise layer. This is a combined sister-PR diff (OSS implementation + enterprise layer), so 'both' is correct.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. The diff alters a user-facing enterprise UI form (ProviderFormPage.vue) — the API-key field's required marker is now conditional on provider type, and new provider-type options are added — so the change is user-facing. There is no explicit opt-out: the trigger comment and feature hint are empty and no 'tests-added' label was passed in context. The only dev-authored test in the diff is a Python API test (tests/api-testing/...), which is not a Playwright E2E spec and does not trigger the auto-skip rule.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because a user can now create/edit an LLM provider using new provider types (openai_compatible, vllm) and the API-key field's required state changes based on the selected provider type (only openai/deepseek/anthropic require it). This conditional validation and the new selectable options are user-exercisable UI behavior that should be verified in the browser.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI changes live under web/src/enterprise/components/onlineEvals/, the online-evaluations product area. There is no existing OnlineEvals area or spec folder in the Playwright ci-matrix, so a new 'OnlineEvals' area is proposed to match where the feature lives.
rationale.group: No existing matrix group covers online-evaluations provider management; the closest enterprise catch-all is GeneralTests, but this feature is a distinct product area. A new 'OnlineEvals' playwright_group (with a corresponding ci-matrix shard/enterprise-overlay entry) is proposed, and the Engineer must create it and wire the new spec into its run_files.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ are changed in this diff — the only test files touched are a Python API test (tests/api-testing/tests/online_eval/test_online_eval.py) and Rust unit tests inside provider.rs/providers.rs. None of these are E2E coverage, so existing_tests_in_diff is false.
